verdict.rationale: Any product with web docs and an API (Parsec has a Teams API) could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this axis applies. Direct probes found no such docs: llms.txt, a markdown Teams API doc, and OpenAPI specs all returned HTTP 404, and nothing else in the pack mentions agent-oriented documentation.
